summary: Prepared standalone v2 release with required generator dependencies, relative imports, explicit environment credentials, complete filtered generated data, newcomer README, offline viewer and executed six-cell read-only notebook. Offline core/routing/retry/data checks pass. Scan of 50 release files against 43 known credential values and token/private-key patterns found no matches. Fresh service provisioning not rerun.

Added zero-context handoff, GitHub-rendered A–L Mermaid diagram with function map, shared Codex/Claude instructions and README entry links. Documented missing separate MES/CRM, zero policy executions, private reference boundary and authored regime limitations. No engine/data/service changes.

Published the existing native company participants, shared scheduler and scheduled Delta ingestion as a draft. A version-1 Q1 plan seeds four submitted customer orders before demand. The live launcher checks provider configuration and preserves the source revision on restart. All 181 root tests and frozen-data checks passed offline. Fresh native commissioning and the live 90-day workload remain unverified.

Added scoped status, stop and start for existing native containers, fixed endpoint ports for new runs and a consistent rollback procedure. Twenty-one offline CLI, isolation and resume tests passed; no service was changed by this check.

Added opt-in planner interviews with maintenance and QA, explicit evidence cutoffs and owner grading; recurring management replies through existing mail accounts. Offline dialogue and replay check passed. Live SMTP and IMAP remain unqualified.

Verified two specialist queries and two replies against isolated native SMTP/IMAP; Jan 4 evidence-based grade, denied incomplete citation, and native IDs survived reopen. Fixed legal leading folding whitespace found by real mail readback. Check used the management response callable in an opening window, with no business clock advance.
Added an animated company walkthrough and a Python scenario matching the published starter. Validated the native plan, the consumer API example with a fixture transport and four Milestone 0 tests.

Packaged the core, validated the README in an isolated Python 3.12 environment, checked two staffing levels and resume, six engine extension tests and the expert inbox checker. Documented engine flow, inputs, and evidence boundaries.
Opened employee obligations task against published enterpriseengine main 583040cd57010d616ba423cb467b28758348c593.
Use the checkpoint and existing business-time queue for role-owned obligations, with journaled native readback references for resolution.
Initial test invocation reported /bin/bash: line 169: python: command not found. The installed interpreter is python3.

Default unittest discovery reported ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'deltalake' and ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'genealogy'. Re-ran with the locally available lake dependency directory and the repository lake module path.
All 5 obligation regressions passed. The 0.2.0 wheel built offline, installed in a temporary directory, and the existing first-run example completed and resumed through minutes 550 and 560.
Offline root unittest discovery passed all 188 tests in 78.285s with the local lake dependencies on PYTHONPATH.
Scoped opening keys to their originating role and retained the stable ID across transfer. Validated the destination roster and added explicitly scoped manager reassignment and reminder priority.

Commit superseded history for started deferred alarms, retain verified native readbacks, reject unresolved unrelated events as closure proof, and expose lifecycle links only in private evaluator truth.
Nine focused obligation tests passed. Offline wheel installation completed the first-run example and resumed through business minutes 550 and 560.
Build offline shortage and managed services SLA examples and acceptance checks on published engine main, then exercise the companion handler API.

Both case acceptance tests and all five companion obligation regressions passed with companion commit 7642a0fbdb538ad6a559d10780413bf3497db377. Separate CLI processes produced one warehouse due event and two SLA due events, one verified resolution per case, and shortage-B and incident-B outstanding.

Default full unittest discovery ran 184 tests with 3 errors because deltalake and genealogy were absent from PYTHONPATH. Reran with the locally available lake dependency directory and repository lake module path.

Combined offline root unittest discovery passed all 190 tests in 149.890s with the lake dependencies on PYTHONPATH. Frozen-data check passed. Case changes were kept on their own branch from published main after exercising the companion runtime locally.
Take over PR #2 from 8e4b98f3cdf334327bf5d96fbdcf0202edc918b2 and stack its examples on the published employee obligations API.
Rebased the example commit onto 7642a0fbdb538ad6a559d10780413bf3497db377. Verified that all six PR #1 and four PR #2 project log entries were preserved exactly.

Warehouse checks credit distinct released receipts against the confirmed shortage scope and quantity. Both handlers record a delivery's event ID and skip another confirmation once the case has closed.
All 10 focused obligation tests passed. Removing each scope filter independently caused both example acceptance tests to fail. The frozen-data check passed.

Restacked on the revised published PR #1 API at ef9ec5e204c6781341b94b5a55b065b7c522fb73. Both examples store stable obligation IDs and the acceptance tests verify one committed resolution audit entry per closed case.

The first full suite on the revised stack ran 197 tests with one subprocess.TimeoutExpired in test_concurrent_writers_merge_and_conflicts_do_not_commit after 10 seconds. The test passed in isolation and on full rerun.

On the revised stack all 14 focused tests and all 197 offline root tests passed. Frozen-data and independent source/case filter removal checks passed. All nine PR #1 and four original PR #2 project-log entries were preserved exactly.

Set 0.3.0 candidate metadata and added the offline installed-wheel gate for PRs and pushes. The gate exercises clock advancement, persisted state and pending work (B, K and L), including a checkpoint seeded by the wheel built from tagged v0.2.0 commit 285eb0423cee85845ec667db2702e0b192a5ec56. When available, the warehouse and service SLA clients are staged outside the tree and run against the same wheel. Release awaits joint signoff.

At adc445cfdaa15a942adad885fb3621963c50662e, the installed-wheel gate passed seven generic runtime tests, the public Python example, and v0.2.0 checkpoint seed and resume on Python 3.10 and 3.12, locally and in the push and pull-request workflows. The gate is being extended to stage the actual managed-services consumer regression suite in PR #8 when present (its unittest fixture requires Python 3.11+).
Stack the managed-services consumer integration on engine/feature/employee-obligations. Keep PR 2's restoration example separate and preserve role-free and saved deadlines.

Existing managed-services goal and incremental entry tests passed before the new API calls were wired. A saved run from 7642a0f with a confirmed but uncommitted response resumed with one response, one breach, and the correct Issue links. Frozen-data check passed.

The initial published runtime rejects the new priority keyword. Verify the integration on PR 1's published stable-ID and scoped-reassignment API once available, including responses at the deadline and after a shift gap.

On published PR 1 head ef9ec5e, all 8 real-consumer regressions passed. Native response and breach replay preserve the correct Issue. An audited reassign and resolve use the manager and relief roles and the verified native response ID. The minute-11 response counts as timely for both enqueue orders. A shift-delayed breach records minute 11 with the action at minute 14.

The two PR 2 cases passed on the original engine. At ef9ec5e both published cases fail when passing short keys to handoff. Both passed in a temporary copy using the stable ID from the role-scoped snapshot for handoff and resolution, and matching that ID in test snapshots.
Full offline root unittest discovery passed all 200 tests in 34.891s with local lake dependencies. Published stacked PR 8 and marked it ready for review.

Release blocker #6: compare the stored Issue Comment content with the action-specific comment, including the ETA minute. Both supplied offline corruption probes now reject confirmation. All nine focused regressions and all ten CLI component scenarios passed. Recovery reuses the same Comment after native correction and a valid response resolves with that Comment's ID.

Composed the repaired obligation API, warehouse and restoration examples, real managed-services SLA and 0.3.0 package gate. Preserved source commits and appended log events. The combined gate requires domain files, and the release docs cover the tagged install and backup-based rollback. Independent validation and Opus review track this candidate in issue #7.

Replaces the packaging input in the preceding composition event with PR #9 at 187f04e0b1cd54aac681e0db85ca6c40fae5c9b6. The additional source commit removes inherited Python import paths for staged example subprocesses.
Baseline at origin/dev 341952e passed 206 root tests, 112 integration tests and 2 QMS tests with zero failures and 6 retained-Delta-fixture skips.
Move both stdlib-only adapters to components. Keep persisted consumer identity strings and the Norvale authority factory path importable, including when reopening a pre-workspace archived release.

Workspace passed 16 engine unit tests, 190 contracts and 114 Norvale integration tests with zero failures and 6 skips. Wheel gates passed 21 tests on Python 3.10 and 30 on Python 3.12, including a v0.2.0 checkpoint reopen on each. Frozen-data, CLI archive and import-direction checks passed.

Moved repository guides, examples, walkthrough and notebooks under docs. Added installed Norvale commands and moved the original wrappers to scripts. Preserved frozen data at data/ and the legacy generator dispatch for archived runs.
Contract discovery found six import errors for the old root generate module. Updated the affected tests to import the packaged Norvale generator.
